title: Ponytail is off until a deep dive finds what changed
why: shiv, Nov 1 11:53 CST, page item 106: "we've had it for months -- something went wrong recently. we even already had kept custom versions of its skills, if none of this happened, then just turn it off for now and we'll have to deep dive. this is a new and big problem."
note: Two parts. 1) Turn the plugin off now: settings.json enabledPlugins ponytail@ponytail becomes false (one line, a lane; the install carries it to every machine). 2) Deep dive: find what changed recently so the whole plugin runs in every session, and where the owner's custom copies of its skills went. Found (lane, Nov 1 12:05 CST): ponytail has been on since PR #96 (ba7a11b3, Sep 22); triage's earlier "first commit, Oct 27" came from a shallow clone. Its "PONYTAIL MODE ACTIVE" line has printed since its first release (Jun 12). Unpinned, sessions took v5.0.0 (Oct 8), v5.3.0 (Oct 16, added the band and board hooks) and v5.3.3 (Oct 29); which change the owner noticed is unknown. No custom copy of its skills is in the git history of claude-settings or claude-sharables; they may be on his machines (page item 122). Done check: ponytail is off on main; the dive's report names what changed and when, or says unknown with what it read. Needs no answer. Lane session_013NEJL1RgpNqGq5FjG8odKc, started Nov 1 11:56 CST (coordinator). Landed on main in batch 53, #951 (merge cdf72a74, Nov 1 12:38 CST): ponytail is off. The dive findings above are its report. Owner local read (Nov 1 16:35 CST, page item 122): his computer runs ponytail 4.10.0 (e3ba2aa, Sep 14), installed Sep 22 08:29 CDT, never updated; enabledPlugins ponytail false; no custom skill copies. So from Oct 8 on, cloud sessions (fresh installs, 5.x) and his local sessions (4.10.0) ran different ponytail versions; the 5.x changes are the likely cause of what he noticed (assumed, not measured).
